data.title: Delays on Bangkok's Blue Line service
data.description: Trains running on the MRT's Blue Line were experiencing delays of up to 10 minutes on Monday due to a "technical disruption".

data.title: Flooding continues in Bangkok and 20 provinces
data.description: The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation reported on Monday that flooding continues to make life wretched for people in parts of Bangkok and 20 provinces, mostly in the Central Plains.

data.title: Heavy rain may return to Greater Bangkok on Tuesday
data.description: The Meteorological Department predicts heavy rain will be in the South on Monday and expand to the lower North, the lower Northeast, the Central Plains including Greater Bangkok and the East on Tuesday.

data.title: Protest ban near IMF venues
data.description: The Metropolitan Police Bureau (MPB) has banned public gatherings around the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC), venues hosting official functions and hotels accommodating delegates to the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings 2026 until Oct 20.

data.title: Retirement scheme near finish
data.description: An early retirement scheme for civil servants is nearing completion, with plans to reduce the civil service workforce by 5% annually, starting in fiscal 2027, says Deputy Prime Minister for Legal Affairs Pakorn Nilprapunt.

data.title: JIC denies delaying new talks
data.description: Thailand has denied Cambodia's claim that it is delaying a Joint Boundary Commission (JBC) meeting and hindering border surveys and demarcation.

data.title: Poverty falls, but 3.6m remain at risk
data.description: Thailand's poverty rate fell to 3.27% in 2025, leaving 2.3 million people below the poverty line. But another 3.6 million remain at risk of joining them if their incomes take a hit, the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) said.

data.title: DDC: No plague outbreak in Russia
data.description: The Department of Disease Control (DDC) said on Sunday there was no evidence of an outbreak in Russia following reports of a suspected death from pneumonic plague there.

data.title: Govt orders checks of care facilities
data.description: The government has ordered inspections of all 1,203 registered elderly and dependent care facilities nationwide within two months following reports of overcrowding, unlicensed operations and alleged abuse in Kanchanaburi and Nonthaburi.

data.title: Dems pose water project questions
data.description: The Democrat Party is pressing the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) to clarify land transactions linked to the cancelled Bueng Khu Bon water-retention project and revive the scheme to prevent flooding in eastern Bangkok.

data.title: Thailand stays in Tier 2  of US trafficking report
data.description: Thailand has been placed in Tier 2 of the US Trafficking in Persons (TIP) Report for the fifth consecutive year.

data.title: SSB election proceeds without major incidents
data.description: Insured workers voted on Sunday to elect representatives to the Social Security Board (SSB), with no major incidents reported.

data.title: Govt denies neglecting flood victims
data.description: The government has denied neglecting flood victims while hosting the IMF-World Bank annual meetings, saying financial assistance had been available since Sept 26.

data.title: Censure debate timeline sparks row
data.description: Government Chief Whip Korrawee Prissananantakul said on Sunday that three days should suffice for the planned no-confidence debate as many of the opposition's allegations seem to overlap.

data.title: Commission urged to rebuild public trust
data.description: Academics have called on the Election Commission (EC) to address concerns over ballot secrecy and rebuild public trust ahead of the next Senate election, due in just over two years.

data.title: Seasoned DNP vet named 'SDG Star'
data.description: The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Thailand has appointed a prominent veterinarian from the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP), Pattarapol Maneeon, as an "SDG Star".

data.title: Streets to avoid during IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok
data.description: The government has advised motorists to avoid some Bangkok streets that will be used for the 2026 Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Group from Oct 12-18.

data.title: Second Thai suspect arrested after abducted Chinese rescued
data.description: Police have arrested a second Thai man suspected of taking abducted Chinese job seekers to the Thai-Myanmar border, after three Chinese captives were rescued and a Thai suspect apprehended last month.

data.title: Flooding in 21 provinces, rain moving South
data.description: Flooding persists in parts of 21 provinces, mostly on the Central Plain, as the northern runoff surge arrives, adding to residual rainfall, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation reported on Sunday.

data.title: Mu Koh Similan National Park reopens Oct 15
data.description: Mu Koh Similan National Park in Phang Nga province will reopen to visitors on Oct 15 for the 2026-27 tourist season.

data.title: Police arrest women supplying laughing gas to Bangkok’s Khao San Road
data.description: Police have arrested two women in Bangkok who allegedly supplied balloons of laughing gas to customers on Khao San Road in Bangkok.

data.title: Ambulance fire in Phuket, no injuries
data.description: PHUKET - A fire damaged an ambulance parked at a hospital in Muang district on Sunday morning.

data.title: Rescuers win most praise in Bangkok floods, not City Hall or govt
data.description: An opinion survey by the National Institute of Development Administration early this month found that most respondents in recently flooded Bangkok praised rescuers, not the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration or the government.

data.title: Cops transferred after venue raid
data.description: Five senior police at Chana Songkhram station have been transferred to inactive posts pending an investigation after a special task force raided an unlicensed entertainment venue on Khao San Road and found several alleged violations.

data.title: Labour minister calls on voters to cast ballots in SSB election
data.description: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has urged insured workers and employers to participate in today’s Social Security Board (SSB) election, which will determine the future direction of an agency managing a fund worth nearly 3 trillion baht.

data.title: PM warns of rain as cleanup begins
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul urged authorities to accelerate post-flood recovery efforts and warned 14 southern provinces to prepare for another round of heavy rainfall.

data.title: Flood victims turning to loan sharks
data.description: The opposition Democrat Party has called for better access to financial assistance for flood victims in Bangkok, saying unclear and delayed relief measures have forced some affected traders to turn to loan sharks to keep their businesses afloat.

data.title: Govt figures unfazed by debate plan
data.description: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas on Saturday brushed aside concerns after being named in the planned no-confidence debate, saying he had done nothing wrong as an official.
